evidence: Scene ids include hero, projects, office, about-us, golden-tie-reveal, golden-tie, and contact.
Transition modes are encoded as fade, direct, overlay, and below.
Per-scene effect configuration names noise, sepia, bloom, contrast, brightness, saturation, lens distortion, motion blur, vignette, and chromatic aberration.
The bundle contains Three.js WebGPU renderer code and TSL node construction.
The application renders a scene into an FBO before composing bloom, color, lens distortion, chromatic aberration, motion blur, UI textures, noise, and vignette.
Effect parameters are interpolated across loading, section, and sub-page transitions.
